concept: Review and integration: a personal approach to weathering hardship without losing yourself in it
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across separating events from identity, supporting others sustainably, and rebuilding in stages — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what resilience means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
